label: A Latin Medical Booklet
summary: A compact Latin compendium of medicine and prescriptions.

value.text: no. 106, Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany

claims.statement: Entered as no. 106 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "a medical booklet in Latin".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Fasciculus medicinae. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Compiled 1491 · Printed 1491, Italian 1494.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition
